_meta.notes: Latvia's Zen presence is the One Drop Zen sangha in Riga, in Shōdō Harada Rōshi's Rinzai line. Harada Rōshi has led sesshin in Latvia repeatedly since 2006.

places.name: One Drop Zen Latvia
places.lineage: Rinzai (One Drop Zen / Sōgen-ji; Shōdō Harada Rōshi)
places.notes: Meets at the Anahata studio on Tērbatas iela. Shōdō Harada Rōshi has led mini-sesshin in Latvia in 2006, 2008, 2011, 2014 and 2019.
